# overlay lower bound

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayLowerBound`](gmeow-overlayLowerBound.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayLowerBound>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The lower bound of this regulatory overlay in a vertical dimension (altitude, depth, elevation), expressed as a [`ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) with unit (QUDT) and reference frame. Optional: absent for purely 2D overlays. Frame-relative per [Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11) (e.g. altitude above MSL, flight level, depth below sea level).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) -> [`gmeow:ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the lower vertical bound of an overlay (altitude/depth/elevation) as a frame-relative [`ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for purely 2D overlays (leave absent) and avoid a bare number without unit and vertical frame ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:overlayLowerBound`](gmeow-overlayLowerBound.md) at a [`ScalarQuantity`](../classes/gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) with QUDT unit in an altitude/depth reference frame; pair with [`gmeow:overlayUpperBound`](gmeow-overlayUpperBound.md).

- ex:ov [`gmeow:overlayLowerBound`](gmeow-overlayLowerBound.md) ex:fl100.
